main.description: Get an HLS CMAF playlist for a video. Returns a master playlist when `track` is omitted, or a single-track media playlist when `track` is supplied. The playlist references each segment + per-track init segment via getVideoBlob, addressed by content hash. The `uri` is an AT-URI pointing at a playable record — today only place.stream.video records are supported, but the surface is collection-agnostic so other record types can join later.

uri.description: AT-URI of the record to play back (e.g. at://did:plc:.../place.stream.video/<rkey>).

track.description: Track ID (stringified u32 matching the MUXL container) for a single-track media playlist. Omit for the master playlist.

start.description: Start time in nanoseconds from the beginning of the video. Defaults to 0.

end.description: End time in nanoseconds. Omit to include all remaining content.

errors.name: VideoNotFound
errors.description: No record indexed at the supplied AT-URI.

errors.name: TrackNotFound
errors.description: The requested track ID is not present in the video's blob.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The record references a blob this node hasn't indexed an origin for.

errors.name: UnsupportedCollection
errors.description: The AT-URI points at a collection this endpoint doesn't know how to play back.
